content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 reflects missing required authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and resubmitting unchanged claim data cannot resolve that defect. A formal appeal remains permitted, and similar appeals achieved payment in 1/6 cases versus 1/12 for patient billing, despite the prior unsuccessful appeal here. The denial does not establish patient liability for the full balance, so another medical-necessity appeal is preferable to transferring that balance or writing it off while a recovery path remains.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
